reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend to older kids or young kids
reviews.text:
Here are a list of reasons why I hate this app:

1: Inappropriate words and things are hidden in the kids shows
2: They celebrate pride, which is unacceptable
3: The shows are for toddlers and are boring/Babyish to older kids/tweens
4: I hate it
5: I already mentioned that it celebrated pride, but it is just unacceptable that an app meant for 4+ would have PRIDE in it. Like, how would you feel when you found out that your child’s favorite app taught them that girls can be boys and boys can be girls?? Pride was never a thing in my world, and it never will be. I am a kid myself but I still know this, and am standing up for what is right.
6: Make the shows less babyish
7: Goodbye

reviews.text: Everyone, I hate dinosaur train! At the very end of the intro, Laura the Gigantosaurus lunges forward and eats the camera. Why teach kids education if it uses scary sounds and visuals? What the people are recording the sounds for are very wrong.

reviews.title: Please..
reviews.text: Guys, guys. Auto playing video..? Is this a psych experiment? What planet are we on? Then casting, it auto plays again! Something you have no intention of watching! And the kid is crying now because they see the show but it’s not the show they want and you the parent didn’t even have 1 second.. not a single. second. to prepare the actual show they want to watch in peace and quiet. seriously the design of this app lacks adjectives to describe it, some words come close, awful, disgraceful, shocking to the conscience. Editors Choice?? Reading this I nearly choked on the Advil I was taking to ward off the massive headache this app produces. Editors Choice?? Only in the Twilight Zone friends. Developers: you guys are good, it basically works, it’s just that some psycho is telling you to build garbage..rebel! Rebel!! Overthrow your tyrannical design and UX autocrats! Boo their ideas! Boo them!!! You guys deserve better. 2 stars, for the devs only.

reviews.title: No more offline option
reviews.text: Our kids are only allowed to use iPads during airplane rides. I LOVED this app because I could download the games before hand and they could play game that I knew were solid, I mean, they came from PBS, right? Now with the most recent update? Only three pre chosen games are available offload.  This makes the app (and their standalone tablet) pretty much useless for plane trips (the WiFi is painfully slow). My kids were soo upset when they couldn’t use their favorite app during the one time a month they’re Lowe’s to use the tablet.  Shame on you PBS. I understand that times are tuff but with the uphill battle you’re already fighting, why make it so that those of us that go out of our way to support you, no longer have a reason to? (I mean, I’ll continue to watch PBS programming. But we won’t be able to use this app anymore.)
